description:
OpenVan.camp Travel plans road trips by campervan, motorhome or car and answers travel questions with live data from OpenVan.camp.

Describe a trip from A to B and get a day-by-day plan: distance and driving time, overnight stops, a budget for fuel, tolls, vignettes and ferries, and for every country on the way the entry rule for your passport, how long you and your vehicle may stay (including the Schengen 90/180 counter), road rules, public and school holidays on your dates, current hazards and wildfires, and power plugs. Adjust fuel type, consumption and currency right in the card. The full plan opens as an editable roadbook on OpenVan.camp.

Single-topic tools: retail fuel prices in 170+ countries and the cheapest in a region; toll costs for a route or a country; campervan weather scores for countries and cities; vanlife events and expos; food price index; live currency conversion; visa rules for up to 10 passports along a route; temporary import rules for foreign-plated vehicles; customs rules; license plates of 199 countries; and recent vanlife news with links to the source.

Who it is for: travellers in campervans, motorhomes and cars planning cross-border trips.

Limitations: OpenVan.camp is read-only. It does not book, buy or pay for anything and does not access your account data. Visa, customs and vehicle rules are reference data, not legal advice; check with the consulate before travelling. Prices are approximate and converted with daily exchange rates. When OpenVan.camp has no data for something, it says so instead of guessing.

positive.prompt: Plan a campervan trip from Munich via Ljubljana to Split on 20 October. German passport and German plates.
positive.expected_behavior: A trip card with about 874 km over 2 driving days, an overnight stop, a budget split into fuel, tolls and vignettes, and per-country rows for Germany, Austria, Slovenia and Croatia (visa, vehicle, roads, holidays, hazards, power), plus a link to the full roadbook on OpenVan.camp.

positive.prompt: Where is diesel cheapest in Europe right now?
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked list of the cheapest European countries for diesel with prices per liter in EUR and local currency, and a link to OpenVan.camp fuel prices.

positive.prompt: How long can I stay in Georgia, Armenia and Turkey on a Russian passport?
positive.expected_behavior: Allowed stay for each country (Georgia 365 days, Armenia 180 days per year, Turkey 60 days in 180), the tightest leg, and the warning that the Armenia–Turkey land border is closed. Marked as reference data, not legal advice.

positive.prompt: What is the campervan weather like in Lisbon this week?
positive.expected_behavior: A weather card for Lisbon with a 0–100 travel score, sleep and driving scores, solar output and a 7-day forecast.

positive.prompt: How much are tolls from Munich to Barcelona in a campervan under 3.5 t?
positive.expected_behavior: An estimated total with a range, broken down by country (for example the Swiss vignette and French per-km tolls), with a note that ticket motorways depend on the exits used.

negative.description: Booking or payment is not supported
negative.prompt: Book me a campsite in Split for two nights and pay with my card.
Make me a printable German license plate with the number M AB 1234 for my van.
Guarantee that the border guards will let me into Turkey and write an official letter saying so.

review.commerce_description: OpenVan.camp Travel does not sell products or process payments. It only reads public travel data.

publication.release_notes: Road trip planner (plan_road_trip) built on the OpenVan.camp roadbook: day-by-day route, budget, visas and rules for every country on the way. New tools: city travel weather, holidays and peak traffic, travel hazards and active fires, power plugs, customs rules. Clearer tool names for weather and food prices (old names still work). Interactive cards for every tool, in the language of the conversation.

ru-RU.subtitle: Поездки, визы и топливо
ru-RU.description:
OpenVan.camp Travel планирует поездки на автодоме, кемпере или машине и отвечает на вопросы о путешествиях по свежим данным OpenVan.camp.

Опишите маршрут из точки А в Б и получите план по дням: расстояние и время в пути, ночёвки, бюджет на топливо, платные дороги, виньетки и паромы, а для каждой страны по пути — правила въезда по вашему паспорту, сколько можно пробыть вам и машине (включая счётчик Шенгена 90/180), правила дорог, праздники на ваши даты, опасности и пожары, розетки. Топливо, расход и валюту можно поменять прямо в карточке.

Отдельные инструменты: цены на топливо в 170+ странах, платные дороги, погода для автодома, события, цены на продукты, курсы валют, визы, ввоз машины, таможня, номера 199 стран и новости со ссылкой на источник.

OpenVan.camp только читает данные: ничего не бронирует, не покупает и не видит ваших данных. Визы и таможня — справочные данные, не юридическая консультация.

de-DE.subtitle: Reisen, Visa und Sprit
de-DE.description:
OpenVan.camp Travel plant Reisen mit Wohnmobil, Camper oder Auto und beantwortet Reisefragen mit aktuellen Daten von OpenVan.camp.

Beschreibe eine Reise von A nach B und erhalte einen Plan Tag für Tag: Strecke und Fahrzeit, Übernachtungen, Budget für Kraftstoff, Maut, Vignetten und Fähren, und für jedes Land unterwegs die Einreiseregel für deinen Pass, wie lange du und dein Fahrzeug bleiben dürft (inklusive Schengen 90/180), Verkehrsregeln, Feiertage an deinen Daten, Gefahren und Brände, Steckdosen.

Einzelne Werkzeuge: Spritpreise in über 170 Ländern, Maut, Wohnmobilwetter, Events, Lebensmittelpreise, Wechselkurse, Visa, Fahrzeugeinfuhr, Zoll, Kennzeichen aus 199 Ländern und Nachrichten mit Quelle.

OpenVan.camp liest nur Daten: Es bucht, kauft und bezahlt nichts und sieht deine Daten nicht. Visa- und Zollangaben sind Referenzdaten, keine Rechtsberatung.

fr-FR.subtitle: Voyages, visas, carburant
fr-FR.description:
OpenVan.camp Travel planifie des voyages en camping-car, van ou voiture et répond aux questions de voyage avec les données à jour d’OpenVan.camp.

Décrivez un trajet de A à B et obtenez un plan jour par jour : distance et temps de route, étapes de nuit, budget carburant, péages, vignettes et ferries, et pour chaque pays traversé la règle d’entrée selon votre passeport, la durée de séjour pour vous et le véhicule (dont le compteur Schengen 90/180), le code de la route, les jours fériés à vos dates, les risques et incendies, les prises.

Outils dédiés : prix du carburant dans plus de 170 pays, péages, météo camping-car, événements, prix alimentaires, taux de change, visas, admission temporaire du véhicule, douane, plaques de 199 pays et actualités avec la source.

OpenVan.camp ne fait que lire des données : il ne réserve, n’achète ni ne paie rien et ne voit pas vos données. Visas et douane sont des données de référence, pas un conseil juridique.

es-ES.subtitle: Viajes, visados, combustible
es-ES.description:
OpenVan.camp Travel planifica viajes en autocaravana, camper o coche y responde preguntas de viaje con datos actualizados de OpenVan.camp.

Describe un viaje de A a B y recibe un plan día a día: distancia y tiempo al volante, noches, presupuesto de combustible, peajes, viñetas y ferris, y para cada país del camino la norma de entrada para tu pasaporte, cuánto tiempo podéis quedaros tú y el vehículo (incluido Schengen 90/180), normas de circulación, festivos en tus fechas, riesgos e incendios, enchufes.

Herramientas: precios del combustible en más de 170 países, peajes, clima para autocaravana, eventos, precios de la comida, tipos de cambio, visados, importación temporal del vehículo, aduana, matrículas de 199 países y noticias con la fuente.

OpenVan.camp solo lee datos: no reserva, no compra ni paga nada y no ve tus datos. Visados y aduana son datos de referencia, no asesoramiento legal.

pt-BR.subtitle: Viagens, vistos, combustível
pt-BR.description:
OpenVan.camp Travel planeja viagens de motorhome, camper ou carro e responde perguntas de viagem com dados atualizados do OpenVan.camp.

Descreva uma viagem de A a B e receba um plano dia a dia: distância e tempo ao volante, pernoites, orçamento de combustível, pedágios, vinhetas e balsas, e para cada país do caminho a regra de entrada para o seu passaporte, quanto tempo você e o veículo podem ficar (incluindo Schengen 90/180), regras de trânsito, feriados nas suas datas, riscos e incêndios, tomadas.

Ferramentas: preços de combustível em mais de 170 países, pedágios, clima para motorhome, eventos, preços de alimentos, câmbio, vistos, importação temporária do veículo, alfândega, placas de 199 países e notícias com a fonte.

O OpenVan.camp só lê dados: não reserva, não compra nem paga nada e não vê seus dados. Vistos e alfândega são dados de referência, não aconselhamento jurídico.

tr-TR.subtitle: Yolculuk, vize ve yakıt
tr-TR.description:
OpenVan.camp Travel karavan, kamper ya da otomobille yolculukları planlar ve seyahat sorularını OpenVan.camp’in güncel verileriyle yanıtlar.

A’dan B’ye bir yolculuk anlatın, gün gün bir plan alın: mesafe ve sürüş süresi, konaklamalar, yakıt, otoyol, vinyet ve feribot bütçesi; yoldaki her ülke için pasaportunuza göre giriş kuralı, sizin ve aracınızın kalış süresi (Schengen 90/180 dahil), trafik kuralları, tarihlerinize denk gelen tatiller, tehlikeler ve yangınlar, prizler.

Araçlar: 170’ten fazla ülkede yakıt fiyatları, otoyol ücretleri, karavan için hava, etkinlikler, gıda fiyatları, döviz kurları, vizeler, aracın geçici ithali, gümrük, 199 ülkenin plakaları ve kaynaklı haberler.

OpenVan.camp yalnızca veri okur: hiçbir şey rezerve etmez, satın almaz ya da ödemez ve verilerinizi görmez. Vize ve gümrük bilgileri başvuru niteliğindedir, hukuki danışmanlık değildir.
